newsitem.title: USA: Taubman files shelf registration with SEC.
newsitem.headline: Taubman files shelf registration with SEC.

text.p: Taubman Centers Inc said Tuesday it filed an equity shelf registration with the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission for future primary offerings by the company.

When the registration statement becomes effective, Taubman Centers may offer from time to time common shares and warrants to purchase common shares with an aggregate offering price of up to $250 million. Prices and terms will be determined at the time of the offerings, it said.

Taubman Centers, a real estate investment trust, is the managing general partner of The Taubman Realty Group Limited Partnership (TRG), which owns, develops, acquires and operates regional shopping centers nationally.

"Taubman Centers' board of directors has not authorized an offering under the registration statement; however, we anticipate that we will use the net proceeds from any offering to acquire additional newly issued interests in TRG," Robert Taubman, president, said in a statement.
He added that TRG will use the cash received for general partnership purposes, including the repayment of debt.
